name: salesforce-for-sales
description: The full Salesforce sales suite for Grok Bot and Cursor — pipeline, deals, accounts, prospecting, and daily productivity — grounded live on your org's schema through the Headless 360 MCP server.

SALESFORCE_MCP_URL.title: Salesforce MCP server URL (set by your Salesforce admin)
SALESFORCE_MCP_URL.description: Headless 360 server URL. Production and Developer orgs: https://api.salesforce.com/platform/mcp/v1/platform/headless-360. Sandbox and scratch orgs: https://api.salesforce.com/platform/mcp/v1/sandbox/platform/headless-360.

CLIENT_ID.title: Salesforce Consumer Key (set by your Salesforce admin)
CLIENT_ID.description: Consumer Key of the External Client App your Salesforce admin created (Setup → External Client App Manager → your app → Settings → Consumer Key and Secret).

CLIENT_SECRET.title: Salesforce Consumer Secret (set by your Salesforce admin)
CLIENT_SECRET.description: Consumer Secret from the same External Client App.
